old: Hungarian complex sentences frequently insert a case-marked demonstrative pronoun ('az') into the main clause that serves as a cataphoric anchor pointing directly forward to the subordinate 'hogy'-clause.
new: You know *arra, hogy* and *attól, hogy* from B2 Unit 17 (*tekintet nélkül arra, hogy*, *függetlenül attól, hogy*): a case-marked demonstrative pronoun ('az') in the main clause points forward to the 'hogy'-clause. This lesson adds the verbs that choose the anchor.

old: In Hungarian syntax, moving an element into the pre-verbal focus position imparts
new: You know the focus slot before the verb from A1 and B2 Unit 1. In Hungarian syntax, moving an element into that pre-verbal focus position imparts
